summary: Russia launched a massive overnight aerial attack with 135 strike UAVs including 52 jet-powered Shaheds and cruise missiles targeting Kyiv and multiple Ukrainian regions; Ukrainian air defenses reported downing 123 UAVs and two cruise missiles with impacts at five locations. Ukraine struck the Khanskaya airfield in Russia's Adygea Republic and conducted Iskander missile strikes on Russian positions in Bryansk region. German Chancellor Friedrich Merz made an unannounced visit to Kyiv pledging continued support. (Source: @kpszsu/82680, @UkraineNow/84471, @UkraineNow/84464, @UkraineNow/84469)
key_points: Russian forces launched 135 strike UAVs (52 jet-powered) and cruise missiles from multiple directions including Russian territory and occupied Crimea/Donetsk, with Ukrainian air defense claiming 123 UAVs and 2 cruise missiles destroyed. (Source: @kpszsu/82680)
Ukrainian drones attacked the Khanskaya airfield in Russia's Adygea Republic, where Su-34 and Su-27 aircraft were based in 2024, causing a probable fire. (Source: @UkraineNow/84471)
Ukrainian forces struck Russian positions in Bryansk region with Iskander missiles and extended sanctions effects to Samara region. (Source: @UkraineNow/84464)
Russian air defense claimed shooting down 559 Ukrainian UAVs over Russian regions overnight. (Source: @tass_agency/398689)
Russian forces used FAB-250 and FAB-500 bombs to strike UAV control points and AFU temporary deployment locations in DNR and Sumy region. (Source: @tass_agency/398688)
German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrived in Kyiv on an unannounced visit, stating Germany's support is crucial in coming weeks. (Source: @UkraineNow/84469)
Ukraine faces a $15 billion shortfall of $27 billion in additional defense needs for the year, per Finance Minister Marchenko. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33706)
Remote-controlled Geran drones struck dry-cargo ships in Chernomorsk port, Bug Estuary, and Black Sea waters. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33705)

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched a massive overnight aerial attack with 135 strike UAVs including 52 jet-powered Shaheds and cruise missiles targeting Kyiv and multiple Ukrainian regions; Ukrainian air defenses reported downing 123 UAVs and two cruise missiles with impacts at five locations. points: Ukrainian drones attacked the Khanskaya airfield in Russia's Adygea Republic, where Su-34 and Su-27 fighters were based in 2024, with OSINT channels reporting a probable fire in the airfield area. (Source: @UkraineNow/84471)

Ukrainian forces launched Iskander missile strikes on Russian positions in Bryansk region, with President Zelensky stating sanctions effects have reached Samara region and new results achieved in the Black Sea. (Source: @UkraineNow/84464)

Construction of backup crossings across the Dnieper in Kyiv, including earthen causeways and a potential tunnel, is set to begin next week to provide at least half of current traffic capacity, per Infrastructure Minister Kalashnik. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33708)
Nova Poshta reduced free storage period for parcels from 7 to 5 days due to air strikes on infrastructure, according to company announcement. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33707)
The Guardian reports Western nations have drawn up contingency plans to relocate embassies from Kyiv to Lviv or eastern Poland if security deteriorates further. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33711)

Russian forces launched 135 strike UAVs (52 jet-powered Shaheds, Gerbera, Banderoil/Dan-T, and Parody decoys) from Orel, Kursk, Millerovo, Primorsko-Akhtarsk, occupied Donetsk, and occupied Crimea (Guardianskoye) overnight. (Source: @kpszsu/82680)
Russian air defense claimed shooting down 559 Ukrainian UAVs over Russian regions overnight, per Ministry of Defense statement. (Source: @tass_agency/398689)

Russian forces struck UAV control points and AFU temporary deployment locations in DNR and Sumy region using FAB-250 and FAB-500 aerial bombs, per Russian Ministry of Defense video. (Source: @tass_agency/398688)

Russian cruise missiles (Banderoil) were launched from Chernihiv region toward Kyiv region, Vyshhorod district, and from northern Chernihiv region toward Slavutych, per monitoring channels. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76034, @kpszsu/82607)
Russian Su-34 aircraft launched KAB guided bombs from Bryansk region toward Chernihiv region, course Semenivka, per radar tracking. (Source: @eRadarrua/119940)
DeepStateMap reports Russian forces advanced near Kotlyne in the eastern front sector, with map updated to reflect positional changes. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23879)
Russian forces conducted FAB-250 and FAB-500 strikes on UAV control points and AFU temporary deployment locations in the Donetsk People's Republic (DNR). (Source: @tass_agency/398688)
Ukrainian forces reportedly advanced on the Lyman sector, retaking at least 200 square kilometers according to Espreso data cited by UkraineNow. (Source: @UkraineNow/84458)
Russian strike UAVs were launched from occupied Donetsk territory as part of the mass overnight attack on Ukraine. (Source: @kpszsu/82680)

Multiple jet-powered Shahed UAVs were detected over northern Chernihiv region heading toward Slavutych and Kyiv region, with monitoring channels tracking their courses. (Source: @kpszsu/82607, @kpszsu/82617)

Russian cruise missiles (Banderoil) launched from Chernihiv region targeted Kyiv region, Vyshhorod district, and Brovary district, per monitoring reports. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76034, @mon1tor_ua/76045)
Russian Su-34 aircraft launched KAB guided bombs from Bryansk region toward Chernihiv region, course Semenivka, per radar tracking. (Source: @eRadarrua/119940)

Air alerts and drone threats were active over Kyiv and Chernihiv regions throughout the night, with multiple air raid warnings issued and lifted. (Source: @eRadarrua/119918, @eRadarrua/119912, @eRadarrua/119925, @eRadarrua/119945)
Russian Geran-5 missiles struck the Nova Poshta logistics center in Chornomorsk and a data center in Odesa, per Russian Ministry of Defense video. (Source: @tass_agency/398684)
Remote-controlled Geran drones attacked dry-cargo ships in the port of Chornomorsk, the Bug Estuary, and Black Sea waters. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33705)
Ukrainian strikes achieved new results in the Black Sea, per President Zelensky's statement. (Source: @UkraineNow/84464)

Moldovan authorities reported missile and drone debris found in multiple districts after overnight explosions, with three missiles and two drones hitting Moldovan territory. (Source: @UkraineNow/84458)

Ukraine's air defense reported destroying 123 Shahed, Gerbera, and other type UAVs plus two Banderoil/Dan-T cruise missiles during the overnight mass attack, with impacts at five locations and debris at five locations. (Source: @kpszsu/82680)

Monitoring channels tracked multiple jet-powered Shahed UAVs from Kirovohrad region to Cherkasy region, from Cherkasy region to Kyiv region (Bila Tserkva district), from Chernihiv region to Kyiv region (Vyshhorod district), and from north toward Kyiv. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76036)
Geran-5 missiles were launched toward Kyiv from the north, with one striking the Northern Bridge in Kyiv causing traffic disruptions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76046, @ukr_leaks_eng/33696)

Kyiv experienced multiple air raid alerts overnight (01:31, 02:57, 04:47) with drone threat yellow level, all cleared by 07:49. (Source: @eRadarrua/119909, @eRadarrua/119918, @eRadarrua/119925, @eRadarrua/119945)
Russian air defense claimed 559 Ukrainian UAVs shot down over Russian regions overnight, per Ministry of Defense. (Source: @tass_agency/398689)

key_developments: Russia conducted a mass overnight aerial attack with 135 strike UAVs (52 jet-powered) and cruise missiles from six launch directions; Ukrainian air defense intercepted 123 UAVs and two cruise missiles, with five impact sites confirmed. (Source: @kpszsu/82680)

Ukrainian drones struck Khanskaya airfield in Russia's Adygea Republic, targeting a base for Su-34/Su-27 fighters, demonstrating extended strike reach into Russian rear areas. (Source: @UkraineNow/84471)
Ukrainian Iskander missiles hit Russian positions in Bryansk region, while Zelensky reported sanctions effects reaching Samara region and new Black Sea results. (Source: @UkraineNow/84464)

Russian forces used FAB-250/500 bombs to strike UAV control points and AFU positions in DNR and Sumy region, indicating continued guided bomb usage on near-front targets. (Source: @tass_agency/398688)
German Chancellor Friedrich Merz made unannounced Kyiv visit, signaling high-level political commitment amid concerns of a fifth war winter and Russian terror bombing. (Source: @UkraineNow/84469)
Ukraine faces $15B defense funding shortfall of $27B total needs; Finance Minister Marchenko outlined $7B domestic coverage and $12B expected from EU cooperation. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33706)

Geran drones attacked commercial shipping in Chornomorsk port, Bug Estuary, and Black Sea, while Russian missiles hit Nova Poshta logistics center in Chornomorsk and Odesa data center. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33705, @tass_agency/398684)
sections.threat_assessment: The massive scale of Russia's overnight aerial attack—135 UAVs including 52 jet-powered variants plus cruise missiles—demonstrates sustained long-range strike capacity and intent to overwhelm Ukrainian air defenses across multiple regions. Ukraine's successful interception of 123 UAVs and two cruise missiles indicates effective air defense coordination, but confirmed impacts at five locations reveal penetration risks. Ukrainian strikes on Khanskaya airfield and Bryansk region with Iskanders show growing deep-strike capability, while Geran attacks on Black Sea shipping signal escalation in maritime economic warfare. German Chancellor Merz's visit underscores Western political resolve, yet the $15 billion defense funding gap threatens sustainment of Ukrainian operations. Russian FAB-guided bomb strikes on UAV control points in DNR and Sumy region reflect continued adaptation of tactical aviation for precision
